steps: Open the court provisioning sheet from Decisions and keep the Player tab active.
Confirm the ration table starts with the head and spouse shortfall rows and that both still carry the undernourishment risk badge.
Check that the focused stipend rows remain placeholder-only in this baseline packet and do not imply any live write controls.
Open the court provisioning sheet and stay on the Player tab.
Find the steward row and confirm it is carried from the prior turn instead of seeded this turn.
Verify the retained override stays visible as Light / Institution for p_court_steward.
Open the court provisioning sheet and review the Player tab stipend section.
Confirm the receipt-backed rows expose Realm Stipend and Retainer Upkeep rather than placeholder-only copy.
Check that the summary card shows 3 coin requested while the fixture receipt evidence still records only the 2 coin payment that landed.
Open the court provisioning sheet and switch to the Debug tab.
Confirm the summary rows begin with provisioning schema, stipend registry schema, generated turn index, person ids, allocation order, and stipend keys in that order.
Check that the focused debug entry rows still expose the steward, head, and spouse with stable ids and rule ids.
